latest_news.headline: Iran NPT withdrawal gains momentum — BRICS/Shanghai alternative framework proposed
latest_news.source: Middle East Monitor / Al Jazeera / FDD
latest_news.text: Iran's NPT withdrawal discussion escalates: hardliners propose replacing NPT with BRICS/Shanghai bloc nuclear cooperation framework. Bill includes cancellation of 2014 nuclear deal countermeasures. 1,340+ killed since Feb 28 offensive began.

latest_news.headline: UNSC debates Iran nuclear programme — Russia and China challenge sanctions legality

latest_news.text: Chatham House: Iran war accelerating nuclear proliferation incentives globally. New START expired Feb 2026 with no replacement. States watching Iran's nuclear program under attack.
